Per the guidelines, the proposal must include a specific, first-person AI transparency statement that (1) is written in first person, (2) names the specific AI tools used, (3) states their purpose, (4) identifies which sections they were used for, and (5) includes a confirmation sentence such as 'I have carefully checked all texts created with these tools to ensure that they are correct and make sense.' The student must add a dedicated section with all of these elements.
